brief:
Today, 10 November, is Push A. Your Legs B from 7 November landed in the log, and it changed the program. Push A has not run since 28 October, so tonight is the first Push A of the week.

What changed: Legs B's squat slot is now a leg extension. On 30 October the smith machine was taken and you did leg extensions there (150, 157.5, 157.5 for 10). On 7 November you did them again (127.5 for 8, 135 for 8, 150 for 10) and wrote that the weight suggestion was wrong. It was. The card carried a smith-squat starting weight under the name Leg Extension, so it asked for one lift and prescribed another. That is my error. If you want the squat back in that slot, say in a note whether the smith is free. From now the slot is a leg extension in its own name, three sets of 10 to 12, starting at 150, taken from your own numbers. Quad sets stay at 13 for the week.

The rest of Legs B was good and the program holds: barbell RDL 135, 185, 185 for 8 (past the card's 165 and 180), leg press 180 for 12 then 200 for 10, 10, leg curl 135 for 12 then 150 for 11, 11, ab wheel 10, 10, ab machine 65 for 10 twice, calf press 200, 280, 300 for 12. Abs and calves both ran in full, so those decisions are closed: nothing changes there. Eight muscles show over their ceiling on paper only because half credit from compound lifts is counted; the program stays as written, because weeks such as 14 September, 12 October and 26 October went through with no pain note or skipped night attributed to volume. The seated row stays at four sets for now; if you would rather carry three, write it in a note.

Tonight, Push A, in pounds. Smith incline press: 155 for 6, then 175 for 6, 6, 6; on 28 October you did 155, 175, 175 for 6 and the fourth set was not done, and those were typed in after the fact, so log all four as you go. Machine chest press: 135 for 10, then 150 for 10, 10, exactly what you did live on 4 November. Cable crossover low to high: 12.5 for 12, three sets, logged as you go. Machine lateral raise: if the gym has one, find your working weight and say so in the note; if it is dumbbells again, 15 for 12 is where you were on Push B (15 for 15, 13, 13 on 31 October and 15, 15, 12 on 4 November), and say dumbbells, and the slot becomes a cable raise or another angle at tomorrow's read. Reverse pec deck: 90 for 14, three sets. Chest dips at bodyweight: 10, 10, 10. After Push A comes Pull A, then Legs A.

Open questions: whether the last Push B slot ("Overhead db press" on 4 November, 50 for 12, 12) was triceps or a press, one word settles it; whether New York's machines are the ones you used in August; and the Legs A crunch that read "Plank" on 3 November. Your logs since 28 October are stamped Meso 3, weeks 5 and 6, while the calendar says week 2 of the restarted block; if the phase tag at the top of the app is locked, the 25 November deload will not start by itself, and "Automatic (by date)" clears it. No bodyweight is logged since 23 August (207 lb). Conditioning: 2 to 3 low-intensity sessions of 20 to 30 minutes a week are allowed in the build block; none is logged since 21 July, nothing extra is asked tonight.

No bodyweight logged since 23 August (207 lb); a morning weigh-in this week would anchor the block.

block.why: Today is the fourteenth day of the block restarted on 28 October at the New York gym (week 2 of 4); it builds to 24 November, deload runs 25 November to 1 December, assessment 2 to 8 December, prep from 9 December, show 111 days away. New since yesterday: Legs B on 7 November, 45 minutes, 20 of 20 sets counting what you did in place of a slot. Nine nights since 28 October have run; the only session never run twice is Push A (28 October), and Legs B is the only one whose first run showed a program fault: the squat slot was a leg extension on 30 October and 7 November, so it is swapped today. The week of 2 to 8 November closed with every muscle at or above its floor except chest (5, with Push A not run) and side delts (7 against 8); quads 13, hamstrings 15.5, glutes 16, calves 9, abs 6. The glutes, hamstrings and adductors done counts for 30 October and 7 November include credit for a smith squat that was really a leg extension, so those three read higher than the work (up to 3, 1.5 and 1.5 sets a night). Progress where numbers exist: RDL 185 for 8, 8 (up from the 180 the card asked), leg press 200 for 10, 10, leg curl 150 for 11, 11, calf press 300 for 12. The deadlift is still under August's 255 to 265 (240 for 5 on 2 November) and has one New York visit; rotating it after one visit at a gym would throw away the baseline this restart was made to build. Dated decisions closed today: abs and calves (Legs B ran as written), and the counting rule (targets stay; ceilings are read against direct sets, half credit is shown but not cut to). Still dated: the machine lateral raise (after the next Push A) and the DB curl swap on 12 November. Next boundary is the deload on 25 November; the prep block is written at the assessment from what these four weeks log.

On 4 November the shoulder press was 50 lb for 8, 8, 8, 8 after 45 for 8, 10, 10, 10 on 31 October; Chennai had 50 for 10, 10, 10 on 12 October and 55 for 8, 9 on 15 October, so 50 for 8s is below your own best, and it holds at 50. Over its ceiling on paper through half credit only; the counting rule is decided on 10 November and the sets stay.

If that was this machine, you are two reps a set under August at the same weight; if not, 105 is simply a working weight here. The four sets stay for now: the row went to four on 1 August so the back day rows at least as much as it curls (six biceps sets on Pull A, against this row, the wide pulldown and the deadlift’s half credit), and whether that leaves the upper back at its floor (direct count, eight of eight) or over its ceiling (weighted count, 19.5 against 16) is the counting rule decided on 10 November: targets stay and the fourth set stays. If you would rather carry three now, write it in the note. Next Pull A: 105 for 11 on all four; four sets at 12 earn 112.5.
